heroTitle: Change your mind. Change your body. It starts with one habit.
heroSubtitle: Every tip on this site is completely free — no sign-up, no program to buy, no catch. Just daily habits we've learned through real experience and continued education, shared so you can put them to use today.
missionHeading: Free knowledge, shared without strings attached.
missionBody: We believe changing your body starts with changing your mind — and that the habits which make that possible shouldn't be locked behind a paywall. Everything here is free to read, free to use, forever.
